metadata.title: Clicked like I owed them a favor and somehow landed that 1 clueless kill?! Valorant logic broke me
metadata.description:
Clicked like my brain was on a coffee break.
Enemy probably uninstalling from pure confusion.
Pretending this was skill for a hot 0.12 seconds.
Click if your aim’s a beautiful disaster but kills still sneak in!

Tap if your aim’s a glorious mess but the game still gives you that win!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
